name: Texas Roadhouse Grilled Chicken Tenders (Plain, No Marinade)
whyItWorks: Skinless whole chicken breast tenderloins cooked tender on the grill. Free of rough breading, deep-fry grease, and fiery spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Grilled chicken tenders plain—unmarinated, NO BBQ sauce, NO honey mustard, seasoned with salt only.' Pair with white rice or baked potato flesh.
